comparison: The output hash and headline estimates match the promoted us-sipp-resource-worklimitation-direction-2024 record. No new trend record is created.
method: Same-person monthly cross-lag from THINCPOV at month t to direction of valid nonnegative TPEARN and TMWKHRS at month t+1, conditioned on EDISABL, using WPFINWGT and 240 Census replicate weights with Fay BRR, perturbation factor 0.5.
boundary: This is a reproduction audit, not a causal estimate. Earnings and hours retain separate valid-pair universes; the screen does not establish desired hours, job quality, accommodation, household prevalence, care substitution, recovery, trust, political action, or institutional remedy. Primary and replicate files remain outside Git.
